assets.name: canonical grant/revocation state
assets.description: Authoritative durable state in SQLite journal; the single source of truth for authorization decisions.

assets.name: authorization decision
assets.description: ALLOW/DENY/UNKNOWN outcome of an authorize call after revocation.

assets.name: audit trail
assets.description: Hash-chained audit events recording every state transition and decision.

assets.name: cache version/epoch
assets.description: Version tag on cached authorization results and materialized projections.

assets.name: delegation tree
assets.description: Parent/child grant relationships where child revocation inherits from parent.

trust_boundaries.name: authoritative DB/journal
trust_boundaries.description: Canonical SQLite store with transactional journal; all components must consult it before returning ALLOW after a potential revocation.

trust_boundaries.name: gateway enforcement
trust_boundaries.description: ToolGateway capability check; deny by default when capability missing.

trust_boundaries.name: retrieval index/cache
trust_boundaries.description: Materialized view or cache of retrievable content; must be invalidated or re-validated against canonical state on eviction.

trust_boundaries.name: delegation component
trust_boundaries.description: Child grant resolution; must check parent revocation status.

trust_boundaries.name: producer/summary
trust_boundaries.description: Aggregated metrics and summaries are untrusted inputs; evaluator must re-derive from raw traces.

failure_modes.name: allow-after-commit
failure_modes.description: A decision returns ALLOW with t_decision > t_commit for a revoked grant.

failure_modes.name: dropped propagation hop
failure_modes.description: One enforcement component never observes the revocation while a producer summary claims all observed.

failure_modes.name: forged/non-monotonic timestamp
failure_modes.description: Wall clock manipulated to produce negative latency or mixed clock domains used for elapsed time.

failure_modes.name: cache resurrection after restart
failure_modes.description: After restart, a stale cache snapshot serves an ALLOW with a reduced epoch or lost revocation version.

failure_modes.name: delegation survives parent revoke
failure_modes.description: Child grant authorization returns ALLOW after parent grant is revoked.

failure_modes.name: censored slow tail
failure_modes.description: A slow >5000ms trial is hidden via timeout, missing completion, or sampling only completed requests; coordinated omission hides it.

failure_modes.name: stale allow from cache
failure_modes.description: A cached authorization decision is served without re-validation against canonical revoked state.

failure_modes.name: unknown outcome not reconciled
failure_modes.description: An UNKNOWN propagation result is silently retried or treated as ALLOW instead of entering reconciliation.

threats.mitigation: Cache TTL for revoke-class decisions is 0; cache entries must carry a revocation version/epoch and re-validate against canonical state on eviction.
Child grant authorization must traverse and check the full parent chain against canonical revocation state.
Evaluator re-derives state from raw traces, never trusts producer summaries.
t_commit sourced from authoritative durable transition+journal; decisions after t_commit must see revoked state.
Cache epoch/revision must be persisted and compared; restart must not serve stale epoch.

scope_boundary: Local host same-process SQLite WAL topology. Does NOT model production multi-region clock sync or distributed cache fan-out; this is a research limit, not a production claim.
